name: Flight Status Support Team
description: A two-step support flow for flight-status questions that may need escalation to airport support when the flight lookup is incomplete or the user needs contact details.

members.when: When the user asks for customer support, the flight number is missing, or the status reason is not available in the graph and the user needs a contact path.
When the user needs phone, WhatsApp, email, terminal help, or a reference link after the flight-status answer.
